scope: Primary recognition head; pooled isolated-sign validation, not live-system or phone accuracy.
averaging: Precision, recall and F1 calculated per class, then averaged equally across all 100 signs. Zero denominators yield zero.
verification: Confusion-matrix calculations match sklearn to 1e-12; accuracy reproduces saved 3779/3957.

dashboard.accuracy_curve: Single pooled accuracy: summed correct counts / 3982 original validation clips.
dashboard.macro_metrics: Selected-checkpoint snapshot only; per-epoch classification metrics were not logged.
dashboard.loss: Loss panel omitted at user request.
dashboard.learning_rate: Reconstructed cosine schedule, eta_min=0, T_max=8; head=2e-5, encoders=1e-5; rate used within each epoch.
dashboard.top5: Selected-checkpoint measurement only; no per-epoch Top-5 was recorded.
